result.summary: Found 3 minor visual issues: a truncated carousel item name, inconsistent favorite-icon styling, and bottom card clipping by the tab bar.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the screen edge showing partial image and truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal list end-padding and apply text-overflow ellipsis so truncated names do not appear cut mid-letter

issues.description: Wishlist heart button style is inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare white outline with no background, while the pizza card below shows the heart inside a dark circular scrim.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent button style with a semi-transparent dark circular background for all favorite icons to ensure visibility and contrast

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card with '-20%' badge is clipped mid-image by the bottom tab bar with no name, delivery time, or rating visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset to the scroll list so cards are fully readable and not obscured by the navigation bar
